The name Nazuk carries the meaning “Reminder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazuk usually hope their child will grow to embody reminder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
